caption: The drawing depicts an object that resembles a machine combining elements of a book and a hand-cranked device. The main body of the object has the shape and appearance of an open book with pages, colored in light greenish-gray for the pages and brownish tones for the book's cover and the frame around the pages. The book is enclosed in or attached to a metal or metallic frame structure with darker brown and gray hues, which has two visible cylindrical rollers on the right side. A metal crank protrudes from the right side of the rollers, featuring a light brown wooden handle. The base of the machine is flat and rectangular, attached to what appears to be another closed book, primarily brown with an off-white top, secured to a surface by a black metal clamp with a tightening screw. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unmarked, except for the artist's signature, "LON CRONK," in the lower right corner.
title: Fluting Iron
